EmailTemplate.name: International Time - Non-Insperity Employee (with Premier)
EmailTemplate.subject: International Time - Non-Insperity Employee (with Premier)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for providing this information. This user has been approved through our Data Privacy Team and can be set up in Insperity Premier and Time & Attendance.
The employee can set up their Premier account by following the linked guide below:
https://help.insperity.com/bps/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2021/11/Creating-a-Insperity-Premier-user-account.pdf
They will use these credentials during that setup:
Last name: {!Contact.LastName} DOB: {!Contact.NSP_Date_of_Birth__c} Identifier: {!Contact.NSP_Per_ID__c}
For security purposes, Insperity will no longer store the DOB (date of birth) for international non-paid users. A generic DOB has been provided. Please advise the user to keep these credentials. If they ever need to go through Forgot Username or Forgot Password, they will need this information.
I've also provided a link to an article in our Help Center that details the steps for setting up their Time & Attendance profile:
https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/how-to-add-a-new-employee-in-time-and-attendance/
Any system administrator can complete these steps. The identifier noted above should be added in the Employee Number field during setup and the user should be assigned to a non-Insperity/non-exporting Client ID. This will ensure they are not included in your payroll export.
Once their setup is complete, the user will be able to log in directly to Time & Attendance via this URL, with the credentials you assigned during setup:
https://timestar.insperity.com/XXX/
Since they are a non-Insperity employee, they will not have access to the single sign-on feature through Insperity Premier.
If you have any additional questions or concerns about the Time & Attendance setup, please feel free to contact our Time & Attendance Support Team for assistance.
Phone: 800-314-8223 (live support is available Monday - Friday 7am - 7pm Central Time)
Email: time.support@insperity.com
Please reference this case number {Case Number} so they know the approval has been completed for this user.
Thank you,
